verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Sumsub serves an llms.txt at docs.sumsub.com (HTTP 200) that indexes its documentation. It also states that appending .md to any docs page returns a markdown version, which gives agents machine-readable docs; the llms.txt entries cover topics like SDK customization, team access, and security keys. Missing for 10: no evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt or dedicated agent-oriented guidance on how the llms.txt should be consumed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Append .md to any documentation page URL to get its markdown version
